officialLinks.label: Undergraduate grades; GPA formula; P/NP; incomplete

helpIntro: Case Western Reserve undergraduate GPA uses a 4.0 scale: A=4, B=3, C=2, D=1, F=0. Enter CWRU credit hours and final grades to estimate current or projected GPA.
helpNote: For the general undergraduate record only. P/NP, transfer and exam credit are excluded. Both graded attempts of a repeated undergraduate course count, so Repeat Impact is unavailable. Graduate and professional programs use different rules.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12 quality points and a 3-credit B earns 9. Together, 21 ÷ 6 = 3.500.

gradeExplanations.A: A = 4 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B: B = 3 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C: C = 2 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D: D = 1 quality point per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.F: F = 0 quality points, but its credit hours remain in the GPA calculation.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete is excluded until replaced by a final evaluative grade; unresolved I grades may later convert to F.
gradeExplanations.W: Course withdrawal is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.WD: Complete-semester withdrawal is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.P: Pass earns credit when applicable but is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.NP: No Pass earns no credit and is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.R: Multi-semester course notation; exclude until the course receives its final evaluative grade.
gradeExplanations.AD: Successful audit is not an evaluative GPA grade.
gradeExplanations.NG: Unsuccessful audit is not an evaluative GPA grade and does not appear on the transcript.
gradeExplanations.NOG: Non-graded course notation is excluded from GPA.

specialTypes.name: CWRU undergraduate course
specialTypes.note: Use final undergraduate CWRU grades and course credit hours.

specialTypes.name: External transfer course
specialTypes.note: Accepted external grades are not entered on the CWRU record and do not enter the CWRU GPA.

specialTypes.name: AP, IB, proficiency, or exam credit
specialTypes.note: Credit based on examinations is excluded from the undergraduate GPA.

repeatPolicy.note: Enter each graded attempt as a separate completed course. Both attempts count in GPA; this calculator does not determine degree-credit treatment.
